انتجبن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَجَبْنَ (intajabna) /in.ta.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# اُنْتُجِبْنَ (untujibna) /un.tu.d͡ʒib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# اِنْتَجِبْنَ (intajibna) /in.ta.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
